card.title: Journey status
card.subtitle: Where the learner stands in each batch
card.error: Could not load the journey status.
card.noBatches: The learner has no current batch.
card.byRiskCheck: Set by the At Risk check

dialog.title: Change journey status
dialog.reasonPlaceholder: Why the status changes (shown in the history)
dialog.bulkScopeAll_one: {{count}} learner: every current batch gets this status.
dialog.bulkScopeAll_other: {{count}} learners: every current batch of each gets this status.
dialog.noMessages: Only the status changes. Nothing is sent to the learner.

reentry.title: Start re-entry
reentry.intro: For a learner coming back after a long break or suspension: the batch moves to Re-entry, fees can restart, and you can add extra classes, a one-on-one bridge class and a short assessment, all in one step.
reentry.batch: {{batch}} the learner is coming back to
reentry.reasonPlaceholder: Why the learner is re-entering (shown in the history)

extra.title: Extra classes
extra.hint: Sit in other ongoing {{batch}}es for a while, each with its own first and last day. Add one per timing (for example Monday 9 pm, Tuesday 12 pm).

reentry.returnHint: Moves back to {{status}} automatically the morning after {{date}}.
reentry.returnHintManual: Saved as the next action date. Automatic return is off in Settings → Journey status.
reentry.returnNone: No date: the learner stays on Re-entry until you change it.

errors.batch: Choose the batch the learner is coming back to.
errors.sameBatch: Choose a different batch from the one the learner is coming back to.
errors.dates: Choose the first and the last day.
errors.endBeforeStart: The last day must be on or after the first day.
errors.endInPast: The last day cannot be in the past.
errors.returnInPast: The date cannot be in the past.
errors.tooLong_one: A link can last at most {{count}} day.
errors.tooLong_other: A link can last at most {{count}} days.
errors.duration: Choose a length between 5 and 240 minutes.
errors.dueDate: Choose a due date that is not in the past.
errors.duplicateBatch: This batch is already added for overlapping dates.

fees.title: Fees
fees.pausedIntro: This batch is paused, so fees and access are stopped.
fees.restartHint: Resumes the pause with the institute's usual resume choice, the same as the Resume button.
fees.willAccess: Access to the batch comes back.
fees.willBilling: Billing restarts and unpaid instalment dates move by the paused days.
fees.required: Tick this to start the re-entry. To keep the pause, close this and resume it later.
fees.running: Fees are already running: this learner has no running pause, so nothing changes in fees or access.

oneOnOne.title: One-on-one bridge class
oneOnOne.hint: Private class(es) between the learner and a teacher to catch up. They show in the teacher's schedule and the learner's live classes.
oneOnOne.paymentHint: Optional. Added to the learner's fees as a separate due.
oneOnOne.paymentOff: Switch on One-off charges in Settings to add an extra payment.

assessment.title: Assessment session
assessment.hint: Optional: a short session with a teacher to see where the learner stands.

summary.title: What will happen
summary.feesRunning: Fees keep running as they are.
summary.noReturn: Stays on {{status}} until you change it.
summary.noMessage: No email, WhatsApp or reminder is sent for anything created here.
summary.payment: Extra payment: {{amount}} due {{date}} (added to the learner's fees).
